# Compute Knowledge Delta

This feature provides the ability to compute the difference (delta) between the candidate knowledge state and the current knowledge state within a given compile scope. It outputs which entities and relationships have been added, changed, moved, or removed, and identifies which entities are 'dirty' or affected by the change. This is core for driving downstream knowledge base updates in a repository pipeline context, ensuring that only meaningful changes are enacted and tracked.
